## General Ledger

Every posting in a period, account by account: the balance brought forward from the postings before the period, each line with its date, document and party, the running balance on the account's normal side, and the balance carried forward. `account` narrows it to one account. It takes the cash basis.

```ts
import { SalesByCustomer, SalesByItem, ExpensesByVendor, GeneralLedger, PostingsReport } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-report-library';
```

### Example
`Reports/general-ledger-2026-12`, December 2026.
